description: React Loadly gives React and Next.js apps accessible loading UI: 30+ spinners/loaders, SkeletonLoader and SkeletonGroupLoader for skeleton screens, SkeletonSwitchLoader for loading/error/empty switching, and loading-state hooks. TypeScript, SSR-friendly, ARIA role="status", reduced-motion support.
rules: For production skeletons prefer explicit `SkeletonLoader` + `SkeletonGroupLoader`. `AutoSkeletonLoader` is experimental; do not use it unless the user asks.
Import the stylesheet once in the app root: `import "react-loadly/styles.css"` (or wrap the app with `<LoadlyProvider>`, which injects styles).
Components use React context and hooks, so in Next.js App Router use them from files that start with "use client" (or pass them as client-component fallbacks).
Always set a meaningful `aria-label` such as "Loading orders".
